title: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Progress Engine

entities.name: The Progress Engine
entities.description: The Phyrexian faction associated with blue mana, led by Jin-Gitaxias, which researches compleation of the Mirrans in Lumengrid.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: One of the five Phyrexian ordinals and the Praetor of the Progress Engine, who rewrote the Phyrexian Scriptures as the Great Synthesis.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: A sea on Mirrodin into which Phyrexian engines pump glistening oil to spread infection.

entities.name: Lumengrid
entities.description: The former capitol city of the vedalken, now a Phyrexianized research center for the Progress Engine's experiments.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane under Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: The Great Synthesis
entities.description: Jin-Gitaxias's rewriting of the Phyrexian Scriptures' Grand Evolution, laying out his philosophy of Phyrexian perfection.

entities.name: Gitaxian Standard of Purity
entities.description: A scripture within the Great Synthesis giving the basic rules and measures of compleation.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian who speaks of evolution, disdained by Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Called the puppet-queen of Vorinclex, viewed by Jin-Gitaxias as a naive beast-creature.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian leader whose temples and theocracy are the Machine Orthodoxy; she discussed ideas with Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian figure whose cunning, vision and ambition Jin-Gitaxias appreciates, though he believes Yawgmoth failed.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian whose necromantic visions are transcribed in the Phyrexian Scriptures.

entities.name: Malcator
entities.description: Head of the executors of the Great Synthesis, deciding what is abomination and what is ideal.

entities.name: Sarnvax
entities.description: Oversees the sective of stitchers, splicers and excisors.

entities.name: Uulbrek
entities.description: Subpraetor of xenomorphology and compleation who designs horrors.

entities.name: Avaricta
entities.description: Subpraetor directing virologists and biomancers perfecting phyretic infection; creator of the crawl-needles.

entities.name: Politus
entities.description: Captured and compleated during the assimilation of Lumengrid, now a high-ranking member of Uulbrek's sective.

entities.name: Unctus the Freed
entities.description: A compleated Mirran who rose to subpraetor and now directs all Phyrexian research into native Mirran organisms.

entities.name: Sheudra
entities.description: A surgeon building her own construct and the most outspoken against the Machine Orthodoxy.

entities.name: Threx
entities.description: A surgeon who harvests Mirrans from the surface personally.

entities.name: Grgur
entities.description: A subpraetor who devised the Meldweb.

entities.name: Meldweb
entities.description: A network of will-stripped compleated vedalken brains bound together for computing power.

entities.name: Prrackx
entities.description: A Phyrexian pontiff and metatect who trapped the Argent Sphinx and transposed its essence into himself.

entities.name: Argent Sphinx
entities.description: An elusive sphinx of Mirrodin that disappears into the æther, trapped by Prrackx.

entities.name: Vrig
entities.description: A high-ranking metatect who unearthed remnants of Memnarch's soul-traps.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Former ruler of Mirrodin whose command center Panopticon lies at its core.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A planeswalker sitting confused and delirious on a throne in Panopticon.

entities.name: Panopticon
entities.description: Ruins of Memnarch's former command center at Mirrodin's core where Karn sits on a throne.

entities.name: The Dome of Synthesis
entities.description: A corroded chromium dome in the oil slick that houses meditation chambers and meeting halls of Jin-Gitaxias and the subpraetors.

entities.name: Fathom Ward
entities.description: An underwater facility in the Quicksilver Sea where dangerous creatures are experimented upon.

entities.name: The Sixth Spire
entities.description: A corroded spire near Lumengrid where Avaricta works on glistening oil and phyresis.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: A spy and the only one to see inside Lumengrid and live, delivering intelligence to Melira.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A healer allied with the Mirran resistance in the Furnace Layer.

entities.name: Vy Covalt
entities.description: A Mirran who shepherded refugees to the Furnace Layer before being caught and dissected by Threx.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Blue-skinned Mirran people, many compleated into husks.

entities.name: Neurok
entities.description: A Mirran people dismissed by the Phyrexians as less useful than vedalken.

entities.name: Furnace Layer
entities.description: A layer of Mirrodin where the Mirran resistance shelters.

events.summary: Phyrexian engines pump glistening oil into the Quicksilver Sea at the start of the invasion to spread infection.
events.quote: During the onset of the invasion, Phyrexian engines began pumping untold quantities of glistening oil into the Quicksilver Sea, to propagate its infection.

events.summary: Lumengrid is taken and converted into a research center for compleation experiments.
events.quote: The former capitol city of the vedalken, Lumengrid now serves as a research center for the Progress Engine's most hideous experiments.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias converts the topmost chamber of Lumengrid into his laboratory to realize the Great Synthesis.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias dwells within the now fully Phyrexianized Lumengrid, and has converted the topmost chamber into his own personal laboratory and study.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias rewrites the Scriptures' Grand Evolution as the Great Synthesis, out of distaste for Vorinclex and Glissa's talk of evolution.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias has modified the Phyrexian Scriptures in their mentioning of "The Grand Evolution."

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias writes the Gitaxian Standard of Purity with ideas from discussions with Elesh Norn.
events.quote: Taking ideas from many lengthy discussions with Elesh Norn, the Gitaxian Standard of Purity gives Malcator and Uulbrek the basic rules and measures of compleation.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias engineers the skites to replace the inefficient vedalken homunculi.
events.quote: Judging the vedalken homunculi far too inefficient, Jin-Gitaxias engineered the skites to fulfill menial functions.

events.summary: Jin-Gitaxias organizes his laboratories into sectives under subpraetors.
events.quote: Jin-Gitaxias has organized his laboratories into "sectives," reminiscent of the vedalken sanctives.

events.summary: Avaricta releases thousands of crawl-needles to spread phyresis.
events.quote: Her latest creations are the crawl-needles, small, biting insectoids that have been released into the surrounding area by the thousands.

events.summary: A few Mirrans submit willingly to the Phyrexians and become glisteners.
events.quote: A small few, however, submitted to the Phyrexians willingly

events.summary: The Phyrexians capture sphinxes to dissect them.
events.quote: capturing the plane's elusive sphinxes became a top priority.

events.summary: Lumengrid overseers alter Karn's throne so they can monitor information flowing to him, unknown to Karn and Elesh Norn's priests.
events.quote: The overseers of Lumengrid have altered the throne itself so that they can monitor the inflow of information to Karn.

events.summary: Politus is captured and compleated during the assimilation of Lumengrid and helps convert it into a multi-tiered facility.
events.quote: During the assimilation of Lumengrid, Politus was captured and compleated.

events.summary: Unctus gives himself to Phyrexia early and rises to subpraetor through self-experimentation.
events.quote: Unctus gave himself over to Phyrexia in the earliest stages of the invasion

events.summary: Grgur devises the Meldweb from will-stripped compleated vedalken.
events.quote: A subpraetor named Grgur devised the Meldweb to remedy this problem.

events.summary: Prrackx, branded heretic, traps the Argent Sphinx and absorbs its essence.
events.quote: Eventually he devised a trap for it and succeeded in freezing its connection between realities.

events.summary: The remaining vedalken and Neurok bond together for survival.
events.quote: the scant remaining vedalken and Neurok have bonded together for survival.

events.summary: Vy Covalt is caught and dissected by Threx after leading Mirrans to safety.
events.quote: before being caught and dissected by Threx himself.
